notes: v0.6.8: fix Modem73 Config TUI Start button. The template had an unclosed <form action="/reset-modem73-audio"> that wrapped the next row, so clicking Start submitted the Reset Audio form instead of /start-modem73-tui. lxterminal is already installed on the g90digi image (verified on g90test, dpkg ii lxterminal 0.4.0-2+rpt1 arm64), so no script or package change is needed — only the template. Cumulative on top of v0.6.6 + v0.6.7: MeshChatX swap on :8000, freetalk pill + Stop button fix, pavucontrol scripts, and now Modem73 Start button works. Verified on g90test: Start -> pill Running -> lxterminal --title=modem73 -e bash -c exec /usr/bin/modem73 opens; Stop -> pkill kills it; pill -> Stopped. Same row on g90digi had the same bug; this release fixes both boxes once g90digi pulls.
